text:
ingrid: Quick RFC follow-up: thinking of adding a 'soft-compact' pass in the allocator that triggers on host-offload/return to reduce fragmentation without pausing inference. Short thread with tradeoffs + candidate APIs.

kevin: Can you sketch the lifecycle? when does it run? background async?

ingrid: Idea: on KV-cache eviction or host-page return we tag slab ranges as 'hole' spans. Background compactor merges adjacent holes when idle slack > X ms. It avoids moving pinned allocations. Runs per-pool, rate-limited.

rafael: How do we measure 'idle slack'? CPU wall-time or GPU queue idle? Concern: moving pages could evict warming caches.

ingrid: Prefer to use per-GPU submission queue depth + recent-request tail latency as heuristic. If tail < threshold we permit compaction. Would rely on existing prefetch/backpressure signals.

sam: @ingrid what about interaction with existing offload pipeline & eviction? Could cause recursion: compaction triggers offload which triggers compaction...

ingrid: Good point. Proposal: compactor only reclaims free holes (no migration of live pages) and only coalesces free subpages. No page movement. So no recursion. It's a lightweight coalescer not a defragmenter that moves live data.

linh: So it's basically subpage-merging to form bigger free spans so subsequent large allocations don't fail and avoid cold spill to disk. Makes sense.

kevin: Implementation complexity: need atomic update to free list and slab headers. Also update diagnostics. Could we reuse compaction bits in allocator? Add 'merge_hint' flag.

ingrid: Yes. Patch draft: show code sample for API: 

```
/* invoked on host-page-return or eviction callback */
void mark_hole(span_id s) { pool->mark_hole(s); }
background void soft_compact(pool) {
  if (!pool->idle_slack_ok()) return;
  for (span in pool->holes) if (span.adjacent(prev) && prev.free) merge(prev, span);
}
```

rafael: Perf: what about lock contention? background thread will take pool lock. Could we use RCU-ish technique?

ingrid: Plan: try compare-and-swap patch to link lists and use per-CPU batch merging. Fallback to pool lock if heavy.

offload-bot: compaction-scan scheduled for gpu-3 in 5m :calendar: 

sam: We should add telemetry: compaction merges, merge latency, allocation failure rate before/after, and a gauge for "holes" per pool. Also flag to opt-out on Dedicated or Private deployments.

ingrid: Agree. Next: I'll open RFC follow-up PR with design doc + perf harness and a lightweight opt-in flag. Any immediate objections?

kevin: :thumbsup: No objections from me. Let's prototype.

rafael: +1

linh: Cool, thanks.

ingrid: I'll drop the RFC link here once I have the draft.
